about:
DC Sheet Metal LLC operates from Lenexa, Kansas, in the Kansas City metropolitan area. The company has served the region for approximately two decades, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

The shop specializes in custom architectural sheet metal fabrication, producing components for roofing systems, metal buildings, and general construction projects. The facility operates Monday through Friday from 7 a.m. to 4 p.m. Details regarding facility size, headcount, annual volumes, or specific equipment lines are not publicly available.

Primary customers include roofing contractors, metal building erectors, and construction firms throughout the Kansas City metro area. The company focuses on serving local trade businesses with fabricated sheet metal parts.

The company has not published a stated mission or point of differentiation beyond its long-standing presence in the local market.
